name: Off-White x Nike Air Force 1 Low SP 'Brooklyn'
story_html: The Off-White x Nike Air Force 1 Low SP ‘Brooklyn’ brings back the same color blocking and details featured on previous AF1 collaborations, including the 2019 ‘MCA’ release in University Blue and the 2021 ‘Lemonade’ colorway in University Gold. This pair makes use of a bright green leather upper with exposed foam construction on the low-cut collar and tongue. Silver foil Swooshes are outlined in black zigzag stitching, with the medial-side check obscuring Off-White’s signature Helvetica text branding. The sneaker rides on a matching green rubber cupsole, highlighted by ‘AIR’ stamped on the lateral sidewall.
